outcome: Evaluate and implement Snowflake AI Data Cloud for unified governed data warehouse and cross-business analytical sharing, under a measured pilot and governed approval process.
overview: Snowflake AI Data Cloud addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in cross-industry operations. The first proof of value uses database feeds, file loads, access policies and consumption metrics. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is time from source onboarding to validated analytics, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: time from source onboarding to validated analytics

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: database feeds, file loads, access policies and consumption metrics; define time from source onboarding to validated analytics and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from IT and platform operations director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for time from source onboarding to validated analytics
